title: Wiki update + H265 hypothesis: Drift-Regime Conditional Value+Reversal Factor
rationale: arXiv:2511.12490 documents a regime-conditional S&P 500 factor: value+short-term reversal signals activated only during 'drift regimes' (individual stocks with >60% positive days in trailing 63-day window). 20-year walk-forward validation on S&P 500, OOS Sharpe >13 (158.6% annualized at small capacity, 33.6% at $1B). This deserves a wiki note in factor-models.md AND a hypothesis entry. Caveat: extraordinarily high Sharpe warrants skepticism — possible overfit or small-cap bias. But the regime-activation mechanism is directly actionable on our 200-stock universe (H181/H198 family).
